import ast
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

path = Path(r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master\brainspace\ccr.py')
source = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
module = ast.parse(source)
method = next(n for c in module.body if isinstance(c, ast.ClassDef) and c.name == 'CCR' for n in c.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'stats')
namespace = {'_STORAGE_ERRORS': (sqlite3.Error, OSError)}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[method], type_ignores=[]), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
class Store:
    stats = namespace['stats']
    _scope_key = 'selected'
    _db_path = Path('unused.db')
    shared = False
    last_gc = None
    def _connect(self):
        return conn
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.executescript('CREATE TABLE ccr_v2(scope, orig_bytes, blob, hits); CREATE TABLE ccr_leases(scope, hash, session); CREATE TABLE ccr_evictions(scope, hash, reason);')
conn.executemany('INSERT INTO ccr_evictions VALUES (?, ?, ?)', [('selected', 'a', 'evicted'), ('selected', 'b', 'expired'), ('other', 'c', 'evicted')])
store = Store()
queries = []
conn.set_trace_callback(queries.append)
base = store.stats()
assert store.stats(include_evictions=False) == base
assert not any('ccr_evictions' in query for query in queries)
assert store.stats(include_evictions=True) == dict(base, evicted_records=2)
store._scope_key = 'empty'
assert store.stats(include_evictions=True)['evicted_records'] == 0
try:
    store.stats(True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('parameter must be keyword-only')
for error in (sqlite3.OperationalError, OSError):
    with patch.object(Store, '_connect', side_effect=error('unreadable')):
        fallback = store.stats()
        assert fallback == dict(entries=0, db_path='unused.db', error='unreadable', last_gc=None)
        assert store.stats(include_evictions=True) == dict(fallback, evicted_records=0)
conn.close()
print('Focused stats checks passed')
'@ | python -B -; git diff --check; git status --short
